_doc: Every skip and expected failure scripts/run_adversarial_py.py lets pass. Anything not listed fails the run.
An entry names the suite, the test id, a phrase the skip reason must contain, why skipping is honest, and where the
check runs instead. A skip that stops happening is harmless here; a new one has to be argued for in this file.
Conditional skips that do not fire today (the eligibility pilot skip, the S03 <3.10 skip) are deliberately
absent: the day one starts firing, the run fails and somebody looks.
